title: Misleading Free Trial – Charged $21 Immediately!
text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ Extremely Disappointing – Misleading Free Trial

I signed up for Speak because it advertised a 7-day FREE trial, followed by a $21 monthly subscription.

Instead of allowing me to enjoy the promised free trial, I was charged $21 immediately.

My Apple subscription page still showed that my free trial was active until November 19, with $0.00 displayed.

This experience completely destroyed my trust in this app. Advertising a free trial and then charging customers immediately is unacceptable.

I downloaded this app to improve my English, not to deal with unexpected charges.

I want my $21 refunded. Customers deserve honest pricing, transparency, and respect.

I cannot recommend this app based on my billing experience.

title: So disappointing
text: Our family tried three different apps to work on Spanish and to compare experiences across platforms. Speak is very much the worst of the three. So many programming and interface build errors. Constant buffering and slow advance between screens regardless of connection strength. Frequently mis-hears accurate speaking and responses. Bizarre jumps into entirely new content before teaching vocabulary, context, or syntax. Frequent confusion with random introduction of multiple tenses too quickly, before solidifying present tense understanding. Very disappointed in Speak and recommend opting for other apps over this one.

title: Title: Please Add Ukrainian and Russian Language Support! 🇺🇦
text:
I was excited to try Speak to improve my English, but I was disappointed to discover that neither Ukrainian nor Russian is available as a native language.

There are millions of Ukrainian and Russian-speaking people who want to learn English, especially those living in the United States.

Speak looks like a promising AI learning app, but the lack of these languages makes it difficult for us to use effectively.

Please consider adding Ukrainian and Russian support. I believe this would make Speak accessible to many more learners.

I would love to become a paying subscriber once this feature is available!

title: Slow, boring. Not for fast learners.
text: Wow. This was… a journey. Between the AI voice rounding robotic and pronouncing words in Spanish incorrectly (it’s incapable of a silent H in “hasta luego”) and the incredibly SLOW user interface, I can’t handle this. There’s no way as far as I can tell to test into higher levels without a premium subscription, so I’m starting at the beginning. I say this with love and kindness: if you consider yourself to be an average learner or someone who struggles, this is for you. If you were a pleasure to have in class that made the honor roll: this is absolutely not for you. Repetition of single phrases over and over within the same lesson isn’t actually helpful when it causes you to be so bored that you check out completely. I’m shocked this app has so many good reviews. I’m trying to be fluent, not a tourist.

title: No es la más peor
text:
I have been using this app for 1 week, the 7 day free trial. I have been studying quite a bit each day trying to get as far into it as I can. 

Until I got to the video lessons? I have tried like 4 times but I just do not care about that cute girl in your app, my guy. Why do I need this back story? I get that context helps with story building, but maybe instead of your story, listening to you talk about a dating app, have a mock up dating app. That is actual context.

Which brings me to what I really do like about speak: I could create basically that in the create your own lesson section or I could set up that scenario in free speak. 

Sure, I make a lot of mistakes in free speak. I’m trying so communicate above my level. I’m trying to say things that see important to me in my life. Sure it’s hard and frustrating to get so much wrong when I get so much correct in the structured lessons, but I feel like this is actual learning. I love it. And that brings me to my final complaint:

I saw a Facebook advertisement for speak. In that ad there is this robot promising to be my tutor. But instead I get like a wax drop with a face mask? It reminds me of…I dunno…a hazmat suit 8bit game or something. Which is cute. That would be a cute advert. I just don’t appreciate the dishonesty is all. It’s just graphics. It doesn’t matter. But it does make me feel like why lie about something that doesn’t matter? Then I can’t trust you with stuff that does matter…like my financials.
